current_revision.mathematical_scope: Given actual local Lagrangian replacement data with unchanged full retained-corner leaves, source compact nodal neighborhoods, the same canonically normalized moment and anchor cuts, the same component core/collar regions, actual marked product/cone quotients and matching whole-fiber partitions on every overlap, the surface proposition constructs a compact Hausdorff closed quotient and bounds the two coarse projections by C eta, eta=(1+log(N_j+1))/R_t. No C1 smallness of reduced changes is required. For one fixed allowed marked tree system along the slow diagonal, the new surjective map also has vanishing distortion and uniformly collapsing full coarse fibers. Constructing atlas-compatible replacement data remains open. Raw moment o(1) need not give profile o(1). Fixed-t free-band Stokes with an invariant primitive and affine boundary actions gives affine reduced area; a weights-(1,-1) source model has area pi(c-|mu|) at period 2pi and does not give an actual P0 area formula. These are external surface results, not new Part I-III inputs or claims of novelty of the general principles.
